text:
Happy 6th Birthday to my sweet girl. 💛🐾

You became my third rescue baby after being saved from being sold on a street corner at just 2 days old, alongside your mom and siblings during COVID.

People say you're spoiled... and they're absolutely right 🤪

You are not "just a dog." You are my family, my baby, and a piece of my heart that walks on four paws.

I made a promise the day I rescued you: that you would only know love, safety, and happiness for the rest of your life. And I intend to keep that promise forever.

Happy Birthday, my little princess. You will always be my baby. 💛🎂🐶✨
